components.name: Worksheet
components.purpose: Method frame (board Worksheet / old-feed LineInput): the student writes each calculation line and the engine checks it against the step's solution graph; the default for every 'calculer / montrer que / resoudre' question of 1ere.
components.student_action: type lines with the math keys and number tiles; tap an earlier line to fix it
components.engine_needs: src/method line chains plus one solution-graph template per 1ere question type (angle sums, Thales ratios, trig ratios and metric relations, vector equalities, coordinates and distances, quarter-turn images, sections and volumes, PGCD / PPCM, powers and surds, factorisation, equations, inequations, systems, linear / affine functions, statistics parameters); named quantities of the figure (AB, AH, angle ABC) bound to engine values; geometric and vector lines judged on several random instances of the figure (as check_ch01 / check_ch05 do)
components.props_sketch: frame type 'lines': graph {template, params}, variables (x, a, k, t, n, b), tiles, symbols (named lengths, angles, vectors of the figure)
components.extends_note: beyond the 3se and 2eme notes (inequality / equivalence lines, surds, pi, vectors as symbols with Chasles, components, encadrements, percentages, scientific notation, N = dq + r, systems by elimination): (1) angles in degrees as quantities (angle ADB = 180 - 80 - 30 = 70); (2) named lengths and angles of the current figure as symbols bound to engine values (AN = (3/4) x 8 = 6; cos ABC = BH / AB), so a line about the figure is judged without coordinates on screen; (3) synthetic vector lines (vec(ED) = vec(EC) + vec(CD) = 2 vec(AB), vec(GA) + vec(GB) + vec(GC) = 0) judged on several random instances of the figure, as check_ch01 / check_ch05 do; (4) prime-power products (2^2 x 3^3 x 7) kept factored for PGCD / PPCM lines; (5) the long-division step 90 = 14 x 6 + 6 written as a line

components.name: CardsPick

components.engine_needs: card evaluators (src/method/cards.ts, claims.ts); new claim kinds for 1ere: angle-pair kind, parallel or not, nature of a quadrilateral, divides / irreducible, order kept or reversed
components.props_sketch: frame type 'cards': cards [{id, text}], evaluator

components.name: PlanCards

components.name: StatementTap

components.extends_note: beyond the 3se spec and the 2eme extension (grouped classes, histogram, cumulative polygon with interpolation, adding values, timeline with index base 100): a frequency table the student fills (frequency, %, cumulative rows), a pie chart with angles 360 n / N, rectangle heights for unequal class widths (the [40 ; 60[ class gets 1.5 cm, not 3 cm), and the 1ere median rule (the mean of the two middle values when N is even), which differs from the 3se rank rule
